params.body:
**Triage proposal** (found while looking into Portal mail:68; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: A platform copy whose Blurit task fails, or whose webhook never arrives, stays "processing" for good, and while it waits colleagues see remove.bg's cut-out with the plate readable. On 2026-11-25, 16 rows were waiting like that, the oldest since 26 September.

## What happens

A platform copy goes to Blurit after its background is cut out (`ProcessImage`), and the blurred version comes back through the webhook (`ImageController::status`). The webhook only acts on `status = Succeeded`. When Blurit reports a task as `Failed`, the webhook answers 200 and does nothing, and the row keeps `processing = 1` and its `processed_uuid` for good. A webhook that never arrives has the same result. `stocklist:clear-processing` exists but is not scheduled.

A copy with a cut-out is shown while it is processing (`Vehicle::readyCopy`, R S1-6.39). That cut-out comes from remove.bg, which does not blur the plate, so a copy stuck this way shows the plate to colleagues.

## Seen on production, 2026-11-25

- One copy made at 10:39 went to Blurit at 10:56. Asked directly, Blurit answers the task with `status: Failed`, `error: Internal error`.
- Rows with `processing = 1` that are waiting on a Blurit task:
  - 14 platform copies with a cut-out (1 today, 11 since 31 October on 6 vehicles, 2 since 9 October);
  - 1 platform copy without a cut-out (since 31 October). It is hidden, but counts as present, so it is never made again;
  - 1 own photo (since 26 September), sent to Blurit before own photos stopped being blurred on 1 October.

## Fix

- The webhook acts on `Failed`. A platform copy is sent to Blurit again as a new task, three tasks in all. After that the copy is removed hard (R S1-6.26), so it counts as missing again and the next save makes it anew. An own photo is not blurred (R S1-6.5), so it just leaves "processing".
- `stocklist:blur-pending`, every ten minutes, asks Blurit about rows that waited more than 15 minutes:
  - a finished image is fetched and written as the webhook would;
  - a failed or unknown task goes the same way as above;
  - a task still running after two hours counts as failed.
params.title: A platform copy whose Blurit task fails stays processing for good, with the plate readable
